description: cache-service in production has a sudden CPU spike, p99 latency is rising, threshold alerts fired, and autoscaling is not adding replicas quickly enough.
user-service heap usage has climbed all day, full garbage collection is happening every few minutes, and requests are timing out after a new session release.
payment-service checkout latency increased after the nightly analytics job started. Disk I/O is saturated and database reads are much slower than normal.
order-service is timing out while calling inventory-service. Retries are amplifying traffic and both services are showing elevated error rates.
billing-service started failing event publishing right after deployment. The service is healthy but message broker connections are rejected.
auth-service cannot connect to Redis after a configuration change. The pod starts successfully, but all token validation requests fail.
api-gateway traffic is three times normal after a marketing campaign launched. CPU is high, queues are growing, and customers see intermittent 503 responses.
three Kubernetes nodes became unavailable in one availability zone. Several pods were evicted and remaining replicas are handling too much load.
the daily reporting batch job missed its completion window, downstream dashboards are stale, and the scheduler logs show repeated task retries.
sms-service delivery failures increased after the external SMS provider began returning 429 and 5xx responses. Internal queues are backing up.
login-service is receiving a sharp increase in failed authentication attempts from a narrow set of IP ranges and account lockouts are rising.
orders written in the last hour have inconsistent totals and missing line items. The issue began after a schema migration and replay job ran.
file-storage has steadily increasing open file descriptors, memory usage is climbing, and restarts temporarily clear the symptoms.
search-service latency caused product-service timeouts, retries increased load, and the failure spread to recommendation-service.
notification-service has consumer lag growing rapidly after Kafka broker leadership changed during peak load.
profile-service database connection pool is exhausted. Threads are blocked waiting for connections and request latency is rising.
cache reads are inconsistent after Redis maintenance. Some users receive stale data while others see cache miss storms.
static assets are failing in one region because the CDN provider reports degraded edge nodes and elevated origin fetch errors.
a newly enabled feature flag changed checkout routing and caused elevated payment declines for a subset of users.
partner-api calls started failing TLS verification after a certificate expired overnight. Health checks are failing for the integration.
database volume latency spiked after storage throughput credits were exhausted. Write latency and replication lag are increasing.
fraud-detection pods are crash looping after the latest image rollout. Logs show missing environment variables and startup validation failures.
analytics-api is slow because one database partition is receiving most writes. CPU and lock waits are high on a single shard.
invoice-generation cron jobs are failing with permission denied errors after service account rotation.
email-service cannot send password reset emails because the third-party provider is rate limiting requests after a traffic spike.
